verdict.rationale: ObsessionDB documents organization-scoped, reusable HTTP webhook destinations, separate from Slack, that attach to SQL-based monitoring rules with thresholds, intervals and severity. That is a genuine registrable outbound HTTP callback, but the only events it covers are alert-rule firings, not a general event-subscription surface. missing for 10: webhooks for non-alert events (cluster lifecycle, batch job progress/completion, schema deploys), documented payload schema, signing/verification, retry/delivery semantics, independent or hands-on corroboration.
